summary: Iteration 64 - Social Inbox & Engagement (Phase 2). All 24 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend testing completed successfully for Social Inbox page and Auto-Reply Rules page. Fixed bulk action API endpoint to accept both item_ids and action in JSON body (was expecting action as query param).

fixed_issues.issue: API expected item_ids in body and action as query param, but frontend sends both in JSON body
fixed_issues.fix: Changed endpoint to use BulkActionRequest Pydantic model accepting both fields in body

critical_code_review_comments: All Social Inbox API endpoints working: items CRUD, status update, reply, bulk actions, stats, mentions
All Auto-Reply Rules API endpoints working: rules CRUD, toggle, suggestions, process, seed-defaults
Frontend Social Inbox page loads with proper data-testid, shows message list with platform icons and sentiment badges
Message detail panel shows suggested replies from rule-based and quick-reply suggestions
Reply functionality works - clicking suggestion populates textarea, Send Reply button sends to API
Auto-Reply Rules page shows rule list with conditions, actions, stats; rule editor modal works
AI reply generation returns template response when LLM not configured (MOCKED)
seed_data_creation: Demo inbox items seeded via /api/social/inbox/seed-demo, Default rules seeded via /api/social/auto-reply/seed-defaults

mocked_apis_list: /api/social/auto-reply/generate-ai - Returns template 'Thank you for reaching out...' when no LLM client configured
